description: Who owns a token — top 10 holders (percent, contract, locked, tag), holder count, top-10 share and a low/medium/high concentration label, creator wallet and share, LP locked %, and on Base the first 25 buyers (bought from a pool or received, when, how much, still holding, share of supply now). Chains: base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche, solana. 404/free if the token is unknown; 503/free if every source is down. Costs $0.02 per call, paid from clink's shop credits (an existing key; new top-ups are paused). A failed or empty call is free.
